subject.title: Memory MVP: add ingestion helpers and CLI/skill surface

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a first-class remember/recall/review/edit/forget memory operator facade in the default memory slot now, route this to plugin/ClawHub packages, or wait for the schema/provenance/write/review companion issues to converge?
rationale: The requested work is a new user-facing memory CLI/skill/API surface spanning lifecycle semantics, and current main already has overlapping but incomplete plugin-specific surfaces.

options.title: Keep As Memory MVP Design Work
options.body: Leave this issue open until the schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget issues converge, then implement a small default memory facade.

options.title: Route To Plugin Or ClawHub
options.body: Close core work if maintainers decide Engram, Memory Wiki, LanceDB, or another plugin package is the right product boundary and no SDK gap remains.

options.title: Implement Immediately In Memory Core
options.body: Add the commands/tools now, accepting the risk of duplicating existing plugin surfaces or freezing lifecycle semantics early.

recommendation.title: Keep As Memory MVP Design Work
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until the schema, provenance, write-pipeline, and review/edit/forget issues converge, then implement a small default memory facade.

likelyOwner.reason: The current memory-core and memory docs history makes steipete the best visible routing candidate for deciding whether this belongs in memory-core or a plugin boundary.
